title: deck.js
description: The default export of a deck's deck.js (spec §6). Importable in plain Node: no DOM, no fetch, no top-level await.

title.description: Deck title; the browser tab title once the deck has loaded.

lang.description: Deck language; engine strings and number formats follow it. Built in: en, es; a regional tag such as es-PE uses its language, anything else falls back to en.

theme.description: Theme folder name under the engine's themes/, e.g. academic-light.

palette.description: Palette name; must belong to the theme's palettes.json.

sections.description: Reserved: accepted, but nothing reads it and it draws nothing. A slide's `section` is the label above its title.

components.description: Deck components, each in components/<name>/ (index.js + schema.json). Names must not equal a built-in; use a namespace such as my.chart.

slides.description: Slide ids in order; each is slides/<id>.js.
